## About the Richmond and Northallerton constituency
**Richmond and Northallerton** is a county constituency in Yorkshire and The Humber. The sitting MP is Rishi Sunak (Conservative), MP since May 2015. At the 2024 general election, the Conservatives won with 47.5% to 22.4% for Labour, a majority of 12,185 votes on a 65.7% turnout. PollCheck's current projection, at the seven-poll average, has the Conservatives on 41.7% and Reform UK on 22.6%, a margin of 19.1 points.

## Sources
Every figure on this page is computed from the sources below. [Read the full methodology ›](https://www.pollcheck.co.uk/constituencies/methodology/)
Show full source list
  * **2024 general election results** · [UK Parliament Election Results portal](https://electionresults.parliament.uk/general-elections/6) and [House of Commons Library briefing CBP-10009](https://commonslibrary.parliament.uk/research-briefings/cbp-10009/). 
  * **Notional 2019 results on 2024 boundaries** · [UK Parliament Election Results portal](https://electionresults.parliament.uk/general-elections/5). Recalculated by Parliament; carries assumptions about how 2019 voters would have distributed across the redrawn boundaries. 
  * **Historic general election results (2010-2017)** · House of Commons Library historic results files (on the boundaries in force at the time). 
  * **Ward-level GE2024 estimates** · Britain Elects / New Statesman - [article by Ben Walker](https://sotn.newstatesman.com/2024/07/the-ultimate-2024-general-election-breakdown), [underlying spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WouOzYujjQmKIFWZzWXdPMiDX4t6hxgvYSPe98rsyPQ/edit?usp=sharing). Modelled from constituency totals; average ~4pp per-ward MoE. 
  * **May 2026 council ward results** · [Democracy Club](https://democracyclub.org.uk) via PollCheck's locals 2026 dataset. 
  * **Earlier council ward results (2014-2024)** · [DCLEAPIL v1.0](https://figshare.com/articles/dataset/DCLEAPIL_v1_0/28999183) (Jason Leman, drawing on Andrew Teale's LEAP dataset and Democracy Club). 
  * **Demographics** · [ONS Census 2021](https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/populationandmigration/populationestimates/bulletins/populationandhouseholdestimatesenglandandwales/census2021unroundeddata) (England and Wales), aggregated to constituency level using the ONS LSOA21 -> PCON24 best-fit lookup. 
  * **EU referendum 2016 estimates** · Constituency-level Leave vote estimates (Hanretty 2017 method). 
  * **MP details and Cabinet roles** · [UK Parliament Members API](https://members-api.parliament.uk/). MP photos are fetched live from the same source. 
  * **Boundary geometry and lookups** · [ONS Open Geography Portal](https://geoportal.statistics.gov.uk) (PCON24 boundaries, LSOA21 boundaries, LSOA21-WD24-LAD24 best-fit lookup). 
  * **Current projection and trajectory** · PollCheck's demographic model at the rolling 7-poll average from [aggregated GB polls](https://www.pollcheck.co.uk/polls), built from the British Election Study Internet Panel (Fieldhouse et al.), Census 2021 (ONS) and Scotland's Census 2022 (NRS).
